string.text: Smooth barrel recoil
More even distribution of the recoil impulse over time improves firing with long bursts.
Rebored barrel
Increases muzzle velocity, thus increasing the flatness of the trajectory. Useful for long range fire.
Barrel adjustment
Reduces bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
Improved muzzle brake
Significantly reduces felt recoil and muzzle climb.
More durable parts
Improves durability of the gun by replacing weapon parts with their strengthened counterparts.
Anatomical pistol grip
Provides better grip for the right hand.
Bayonet
Standard 6x5 bayonet allows to use the weapon in melee combat.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts.
Improved feeding mechanism
Reduces the number of malfunctions related to feeding issues.
45 round magazine (black)
Extended magazine allows to decrease the number of reloads in combat, increasing chances of survival.
45 round magazine (brown)
Extended magazine allows to decrease the number of reloads in combat, increasing chances of survival.
60 round magazine
High capacity magazine allows to send even more enemies to a better place with a single continuous burst.
Recoil pad
Recoil pad from GP-25 accessories' kit dampens felt recoil
Lightweight stock
Reduces weight, allowing to carry extra ammo or an additional artifact into a raid.
Reinforced bolt carrier
Makes the bolt carrier more resistant to wear and damage, improving reliability.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Trigger tuning
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Balanced bolt carrier
Reduces the muzzle climb, as well as reduces the probability of malfunctions.
